concerns.text: FR-009 (VLM proxy validation gate) is referenced in T041, but the task description contains an unresolved claim marker '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_739980a2 — status=not_enough_info]' regarding the sample size threshold. This prevents the task from being executable as a definitive gate, leaving the FR-009 requirement unfulfilled by a concrete implementation step.

FR-006 (Linear scaling validation) and SC-002 (RAM constraint) rely on T023b producing `data/profiling_logs.json`. However, T023b is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) and the Analyze Report indicates it was previously rejected for schema mismatch. Without a completed, valid T023b, the downstream tasks T021b, T021, and T024 cannot execute, leaving FR-006 and SC-002 uncovered by a functional task chain.

FR-008 (Dimension classification logic) requires T017 to flag dimensions. T017 is marked incomplete. Furthermore, T017 depends on T019 (Baseline comparisons), which is also incomplete. The chain T012/T013 (Feature Extraction) -> T015 (Training) -> T016 (Correlation) -> T017 is broken at the extraction and baseline steps, leaving the core FR-008 requirement without a completed task path.

FR-005 (Threshold sensitivity analysis) and US3 require T033 (Threshold Sweep) and T027 (Flip Rate). T033 depends on T016 (Correlations), which is blocked by incomplete T012/T013. T027 depends on T033. Consequently, the entire US3 implementation chain is broken, leaving FR-005 and SC-004 (Methodological verification) without executable tasks.

T011 (Integration test) description includes a placeholder citation '(Reference: Smith et al.,)' with no year or DOI. While tests are optional, if included, they should not contain broken or incomplete citations that violate the 'Verified Accuracy' principle of the Constitution.
